title: Finite constant coefficients in proper smooth curve families
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme (locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]) and $f:C\to S$ a proper smooth morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] with nonempty geometrically connected fibres [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] of dimension at most one [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and $M$ a finite $\Lambda$-module. For every integer $q$, $R^qf_*\underline M$ is a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $S_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. No invertibility of the additive exponent of $M$ on $S$ is assumed.
